# ADR-3275: AWS tagging_compute: Admin IAM instance profile for web ASG 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Overprivileged instance roles are a prime target.

## Decision

Web tiers MUST NOT attach an admin IAM instance profile for web ASG 3 (AWS-tagging_compute-3).

## Consequences

Roles grant only the API calls needed.
